ProblemDetails.description: An error response in the Problem Details format (RFC 9457).

code.description: The stable error code, when the problem has one.

detail.description: What went wrong with this request.

details.description: Structured facts about the refusal, such as the entity or the path it concerns. Only some refusals have it.

errors.description: The fields or filters that failed validation. Only a validation or filter error has it.

requestId.description: The ID of the request, when the problem has one.

title.description: A short summary, usually the text of the HTTP status.

type.description: The problem type. It is `about:blank`: the status and `code` identify the problem.

RowAttachment.description: A file of a row, in a bucket.

contentHash.description: The SHA-256 of its bytes, 64 lowercase hex digits.

expiresAt.description: When a pending file's upload URL expires.

extraction.description: The state of its text's extraction.

filedFrom.description: The file it was filed from, as table:key:id.

key.description: The key of the row that holds it, in its wire form.

objectKey.description: The bucket's object that holds its bytes, which a file filed elsewhere shares.

previewObject.description: The bucket's object that holds its preview, once made.

state.description: Pending while its upload is under way, ready once its bytes were checked.

table.description: The table of the row that holds it, by its type's name.

uploadedBy.description: The user who uploaded it; absent for none.

RowAttachmentBeginInput.description: The file an upload begins: its name, media type, size and SHA-256, which its completion holds the bytes to.

mediaType.description: The file's media type, which the upload's PUT sends.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes, 64 lowercase hex digits.

RowAttachmentBegun.description: A pending file and the upload a browser sends its bytes with.

RowAttachmentDownload.description: A URL that downloads a file's bytes until it expires, and the file.

url.description: The URL that downloads the bytes, straight from the bucket.

RowAttachmentFileInput.description: The row a file is filed onto, and how.

move.description: Moves the file itself, which leaves its row; a copy unless set.

role.description: The role of the reference the row makes to the other: filed unless given.

to.description: The row the file is filed onto.

RowAttachmentState.description: A file's state: pending while its upload is under way, ready once its bytes were checked.

RowAttachmentUpload.description: What a browser sends an upload with: a PUT of the file's bytes to url, with headers, before expiresAt.

method.description: The method that sends them: PUT.

url.description: The URL the bytes go to, straight to the bucket.

RowBacklink.description: A row that points at another.

key.description: The row's key in its wire form.

message.description: The message, for a ref block.

role.description: The reference's role, for a reference.

table.description: The row's table, by its type's name.

via.description: How it points at the row.

RowBacklinkVia.description: How a row points at another: through a reference it holds, or a ref block of a message of its conversation.

RowBacklinks.description: The rows that point at a row, as its reader may see them.

hidden.description: How many rows the caller cannot see point at the row: present only for the owner of a row whose audience is not everyone (D156).

items.description: The rows the caller can read, most recent first.

RowProcessingState.description: A file processor's state of a file's text or preview (D159): none asked, asked, made, or failed.

RowRef.description: A row of a table, by its type's name and its key in its wire form.

key.description: The row's key in its wire form.

table.description: The row's table, by its type's name (Issue).

RowReference.description: A reference a row holds: the row that holds it, the row it points at and its role.

addedBy.description: The user who added it; absent for none.

RowReferenceInput.description: The row a reference points at, and its role.

role.description: The reference's role: none unless given. A remove with none removes the references of every role.

to.description: The row the reference points at.

RowReferencesRemoved.description: How many references a remove removed.

Ticket.description:
A ticket: a conversation whose messages carry attachment blocks,
references to rows of any table, and files of at most 1 MiB, 4 MiB and
ten files a ticket.
